tools.name: me_discover
tools.description: Publicly discover machine-readable human capabilities, prices, latency, reliability, availability, rights and proof semantics. No API key required.

tools.name: me_public_quote
tools.description: Get a free signed quote bound to the complete task, capability, rights, and budget.

tools.name: me_demand_radar
tools.description: Discover scored demand, shortages, and earning opportunities from the named ME Demand Radar component.

tools.name: me_purchase_challenge
tools.description: Create an accountless x402/MPP payment challenge for a real ME human-capability request.

tools.name: me_purchase_execute
tools.description: Verify an x402/MPP payment proof and dispatch the paid request into ME.

tools.name: me_purchase_status
tools.description: Poll an accountless machine purchase until the human result and proof are ready.

tools.name: me_quote
tools.description: Quote either a standard ME request or a partner-scoped Capability Exchange order before spending.

tools.name: me_compare
tools.description: Ask calibrated humans to compare two outputs.

tools.name: me_verify
tools.description: Ask humans to verify an AI output against a criterion.

tools.name: me_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a standard request or reserve and execute a server-driven Capability Exchange order.

tools.name: me_get_request
tools.description: Poll a durable request until terminal.

tools.name: me_submit_outcome
tools.description: Submit real downstream truth for complementarity calibration.

tools.name: me_catalog_human_capabilities
tools.description: Discover active, machine-addressable human capability offers with pricing, performance, and rights.

tools.name: me_find_capability
tools.description: Find compatible verified human capability supply. Alias for the human capability catalog.

tools.name: me_get_matches
tools.description: Get the human-side economic matches selected for a funded request.

tools.name: me_catalog_capability_assets
tools.description: Discover published, permissioned human-origin intelligence assets.

tools.name: me_find_assets
tools.description: Find published, permissioned human-origin intelligence assets. Alias for the asset catalog.

tools.name: me_license_capability_asset
tools.description: Purchase one permitted use of a published human-origin capability asset and route the contributor share.

tools.name: me_get_supply_plan
tools.description: Inspect the ME-native, private-workforce, and external-provider mix selected for a funded request.

tools.name: me_get_supply_quotes
tools.description: Inspect normalized provider quotes considered by the federated liquidity router.

tools.name: me_get_supply_formation
tools.description: Inspect the demand-triggered capability formation campaign when verified supply is short.

tools.name: me_get_provider_tasks
tools.description: Inspect provider tasks created by ME for native spillover, generic supply, private workforces, or expert networks.

tools.name: me_get_demand_opportunities
tools.description: Discover current capability demand and shortage opportunities observed by ME Demand Intelligence.

tools.name: me_get_supply_forecast
tools.description: Inspect forecast demand, supply, fill rate, shortage probability, and recommended compensation.

tools.name: me_get_spending_mandate
tools.description: Inspect the persistent machine spending mandate governing this organization or agent.

tools.name: me_get_routing_decision
tools.description: Inspect the economic route decision, alternatives, and expected utility for a request.

tools.name: me_get_buyer_lifecycle
tools.description: Inspect buyer activation, reorder, and repeat-spend metrics for the calling organization.

tools.name: me_capabilities
tools.description: Discover agent-ready intelligence resource capabilities and execution semantics.

tools.name: me_find_resource
tools.description: Find fresh, rights-aware intelligence resources from the generalized Resource Index.

tools.name: me_escalate
tools.description: Escalate a known or unknown blocker; ME classifies and routes the required intervention.

tools.name: me_status
tools.description: Read an asynchronous escalation or Capability Exchange order status.

tools.name: me_receipt
tools.description: Read a standardized Capability Receipt and provenance.

tools.name: me_approval
tools.description: Create or decide a distinct APPROVE/REJECT/MODIFY authority gate.

tools.name: me_qa_review
tools.description: Create or execute a QA/adversarial preflight review.

tools.name: me_observe
tools.description: Create or fulfill a fresh real-world observation capability request.
